as_of_content:
'''Evasion''' buffs are abilities that makes a Bot automatically dodge attacks. Three types of Evade exist: '''Melee Evade''' and '''Ranged Evade''', in addition to a '''general Evade'''.

== Bots with this buff ==
*All [[Scout]]s have this buff in one way or another.
* [[Bumblebee (DOTM)]] is the only non-Scout to have an Evade buff.

latest_content:
[[File:Buff Evade Melee.png|thumb]]
'''Evasion''' buffs are abilities that makes a Bot automatically dodge away from attacks. Evade can be attack specific: '''Evade Melee''',  '''Evade''' '''Ranged,''' and '''Evade Special''' , in addition to Evade All. Some bots have instances of Evading instantly without buffs.

== Bots ==

* [[Arcee]] (instant ranged)
* [[Barricade]] (all)
* [[Bumblebee (DOTM)]] (melee or ranged) 
* [[Bumblebee]] (melee)
* [[Cheetor]] (ranged)
* [[Jazz]] (all)
* [[Kickback]] (instant heavy)
* [[Prowl]] (all)
* [[Sideswipe]] (melee)
* [[Skywarp]] (specials)
* [[Starscream]] (instant heavy melee, synergy ranged)
* [[Sunstreaker]] (melee)

Some modules like the [[Nightbird's Mark]] can add evade buff to any bot.

[[Category:Buffs]]
[[Category:Gameplay]]
